warnings: Spread-footing alternative (S-02 view1), 'ขยายฐานรากแบบแผ่' F1, F2 with 'BEARING-10 Ton/Sq.m.'. element_type 'footing', footing_type 'spread_footing' — same marks as the pile caps on S-08 but different members.

Mats are printed 'N+N-DBxxmm.#' (two-way mesh): count = the sum, printed text in count_printed_as. F2 tapers from 0.40 at the column to 0.25 at the edge: height_mm is the thickness at the column, the edge in height_mm_printed_as.
The footing depth D below original ground (ระดับดินเดิม) is not given a number on this sheet (S-08's NOTE gives ~1.50 m for the pile caps).
